name: Contabo
tagline: German VPS and dedicated server provider with unusually high specs for the price
description: Contabo is a German cloud VPS and dedicated server provider known for packing far more RAM, CPU and storage into each plan than most competitors at the same price point — aimed at developers and self-managed users rather than beginners who want a control panel out of the box.
about: Contabo's Cloud VPS lineup runs from Cloud VPS 4 (4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 100GB SSD) at an effective €5.50/month up through Cloud VPS 18 (18 vCPU, 96GB RAM, 600GB SSD) at €49/month, with several tiers in between (VPS 6, 8, 12 and 16). The quoted rate is the effective monthly price on a 24-month subscription; the minimum contract length is one month, but shorter terms cost more per month. Every plan includes unlimited traffic, DDoS protection, a firewall and dedicated IPv4/IPv6 addresses, with data centers across roughly 11 locations worldwide including the US, UK, Europe, Singapore, Japan, India and Australia.

Contabo does not bundle cPanel or any control panel by default — plans ship as raw Linux (or Windows) compute, so installing and managing a panel like cPanel, Plesk or CyberPanel is on the buyer, which is a large part of why the specs-per-dollar ratio is so high. Trustpilot reviews skew strongly positive (4.6/5 across over 11,000 reviews, with about 77% five-star), praising value for money and server reliability, but a meaningful minority of one-star reviews cite slow or inconsistent support response times and occasional account-access friction — worth weighing if you'd need hands-on help rather than a self-managed setup.
policies: Contabo offers a 14-day revocation/money-back period for private accounts (business accounts and domain purchases are excluded), and separately allows refund requests within 72 hours of an unwanted automatic renewal — refund eligibility and any extra fees are handled through Contabo's support ticket system rather than automatically.

Private accounts can request a refund within 14 days of purchase under Contabo's revocation policy; domain purchases are excluded. There's also a separate window to request a refund within 72 hours of an unwanted automatic renewal.

Reviews are mixed on this point. Contabo holds a strong 4.6/5 rating on Trustpilot overall, with many users praising responsive support, but a notable share of one-star reviews specifically cite slow or frustrating support experiences — so quality may vary by ticket type or time zone.
